findings.claim: Original 00411B30 looks up signed zone ID from 80x80 map 00439EF0, optionally invokes original 004125A0 to reserve the first empty header of 80 0x8004-strided plane-0 zone slots and stores its ID in the map. Native original instructions were executed for empty, existing, two allocations and out-of-range zones.
findings.limitations: The UI refresh thunk was substituted; test map/header state synthetic.

findings.claim: Original 00411810 reset mode 0 initializes zone-map entries to 0xFF and terrain-workplane missing-height values to 0x8000 with slot headers zero, independently of 00411B30 first-touch ID allocation. Original default plane-2 surface is initialized from 00433A70 (initial value 1).
findings.limitations: Original initialization was assembly/decompilation cross-checked, not executed end-to-end with Windows UI. Native emulation tests manually initialize correct defaults.

findings.claim: Executing original terrain services, missing-zone height read selector 100 and material read return -1 without allocation, while selector 1 height read allocates zone ID 0 and returns unset 0x8000; subsequent original height and material writers/readers exchange 600/6.
findings.limitations: Only the UI/display refresh routine intercepted and synthetic startup state supplied; no original editor UI executed.

findings.claim: Original rasterizer/classifier/neighbor repair plus original terrain accessors and original zone allocator created an initially unmapped adjacent zone (ID 1) in modes 3 and 5, whereas modes 2 and 4 left it absent for an identical synthetic seam fixture. Mode 3 finished with 26 valid-height cells; mode 5 with only the original seed.
findings.limitations: Specific synthetic road section and terrain memory, original UI refresh substituted; Ghidra x87 behavior may not be bit-exact for fractional geometry.

findings.claim: With all 80 base-plane headers occupied, original zone allocation returns -1 and leaves the map byte 0xFF, but the 00411B30 path still sends -1 as argument to display refresh 0040124E.
findings.limitations: Refresh was deliberately intercepted, so a crash, UI defect or reachable original game/editor failure is NOT established.

findings.claim: Static native 00411BE0 and interactive caller 00413B20 suggest zone deletion and slot compaction, with remapping of zone bytes, object lists and multiple per-zone terrain planes; these lifecycle effects have not been confirmed in original-code execution.
findings.limitations: No native deletion/compaction experiment, caller/UI state or full object metadata integrity check; provisional research-only interpretation.
